native_result.query: Between which two races is the factor of BA degree completion -0.9568 when compared to the other?
native_result.HypoA: There is a racial differential in BA degree completion rates between Black and White students with a factor of -0.9568.
native_result.HypoB: The factor of BA degree completion is -0.9568 when comparing Black individuals to White individuals (with White individuals as the reference group) in a logistic regression model interacting race with socioeconomic status (SES). At baseline socioeconomic status, Black individuals have a significantly lower log-odds of completing a BA degree compared to White individuals (beta = -0.9568, p < 0.001).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. 遍历并拟合了全样本与两两子样本的单变量及多元 Logistic 回归、OLS 回归与交互效应模型；2. 精确定位在 BA ~ SAMPLE_RACE * SES 模型中，Black 相比于 White 的主效应对数几率因子精确为 -0.9568；3. 进一步纳入 ASVAB 成绩、班级排名等学术表现指标进行模型敏感度与机制分析，验证了模型稳健性与学术背景对种族差距的调节中介作用。
